============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 10,135 ns | 98,670 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 18,095 ns | 55,265 | 366 | 1.79x slower |
| protobuf-py | 1,277 ns | 783,224 | 341 | 7.94x faster |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 573 ns | 1,745,025 | 341 | 17.69x faster |
| msgspec | 809 ns | 1,236,439 | 634 | 12.53x faster |
| msgpack | 2,669 ns | 374,648 | 634 | 3.80x faster |
| json (stdlib) | 6,297 ns | 158,811 | 874 | 1.61x faster |

| msgpack | 3,544 ns | 282,205 | 5.25x faster |
| json (stdlib) | 5,925 ns | 168,790 | 3.14x faster |
